use: Ranking candidate RNA cells for an ATAC-only cell (finding its cross-modal neighborhood) in data like this: one donor, one batch, same 10x Multiome chemistry
reason: Lower FOSCTTM than CCA by far more than the seed SD (0.01059 vs 0.01522), and the true partner is in the top 50 of 1927 RNA cells for 0.87667 of ATAC queries vs 0.8106 for CCA. Scored on same-nucleus pairs, so this is an optimistic bound for separately measured experiments.

use: Exact one-to-one pairing of an ATAC cell with its own RNA profile
reason: The top-ranked RNA cell is the true partner for only 0.17313 of ATAC queries (median rank 8 of 1927). That is far above chance (0.0005) and above CCA (0.1287), but most top-1 matches are a similar cell, not the same cell; use the space for neighborhoods, not identity.

use: Transferring cell_type from RNA-annotated cells to ATAC-only cells with a kNN classifier in the shared space
reason: Works well with kNN: accuracy 0.93513 (SD 0.0009) and macro-F1 0.89163 (SD 0.00171) over 17 classes, against majority-class macro-F1 0.0247, and close to an ATAC classifier trained on ATAC's own labels (kNN macro-F1 0.9148). Condition: there is no clear difference from CCA (macro-F1 0.8886, accuracy 0.9324), so the learned space is not needed for this use; the labels themselves come from a joint RNA+ATAC clustering, so accuracy measures agreement with that annotation.

use: Transferring cell_type with a linear (logistic-regression) classifier fit on RNA embeddings and applied to ATAC embeddings
reason: In this space the linear transfer is worse than CCA's by more than the seed SD: macro-F1 0.82567 (SD 0.01705) vs 0.8749, accuracy 0.893 (SD 0.00898) vs 0.9277. Use kNN transfer here, or CCA if a linear classifier is required.

use: Separating fine T-cell subtypes (Treg, gdT, CD8 TEM_1) from ATAC
reason: Per-class F1 is only measured for ATAC classifiers trained on ATAC labels (per-class F1 for transfer is not produced). Even there, Treg (0.69743), gdT (0.7694) and CD8 TEM_1 (0.79787) are the weakest classes in the shared space, against 0.98153 for CD14 Mono, so transferred labels for these subtypes should be checked before use.

use: Annotating HSPC and Plasma cells, or applying the model to other donors, batches or separately run RNA and ATAC experiments
reason: Not measured. HSPC (17 cells) and Plasma (12 cells) were excluded from label scoring, and the data are one donor and one batch with RNA and ATAC from the same nucleus, so neither rare-class transfer nor cross-batch matching was tested. A second donor or a truly separate RNA and ATAC experiment would be needed.
